description: Excel-style "Format Cells" dialog for editing the style of the selected spreadsheet cells. Presents Number, Alignment, Font, Border, and Fill tabs with a live preview, and raises OnApply with the resulting SpreadsheetCellStyle. The number-category picker is a WAI-ARIA listbox with a roving tabindex: the selected option is the tab stop and owns the focus, Up/Down/Home/End move the selection. Ctrl+Enter still applies the dialog.
